coaching.headline: Objectives won this. The duo lane kept bleeding, and Greystone was a fucking wall.
coaching.team: We gave up first blood and lost an early two-for-nothing in our own jungle, then won the full five-on-five over Fangtooth and ran the objectives from there: Mini Prime, Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth and five towers to their two. Six of seven won fights turned into a prize, which is how a game should get closed. Clean enough to win, sloppy enough to get punished by a better team.

focus.title: Stop fighting as a pair
focus.action: Both fights Drongo and Phase took as a two-man pair were lost, and the second came right before their only Fangtooth. Next game, the duo pulls in a third teammate before engaging near an objective. Check how many duo deaths land just before an enemy objective.

perPlayer.3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a: Greystone was the best player in the lobby, and it was not close. No deaths, the most damage mitigated on the team and our top hero damage on top of it: that is a frontline doing the whole fucking job. The standard to hold is simple. When the enemy brings two knockups like Grux and Kwang did, Greystone goes in first so those knockups land on him, and Drongo and Gideon fight from behind him.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera turned this into a demolition job. More objective damage than the other four combined, while dying less than his usual, is the jungler winning the game through the map rather than the scoreboard. One condition to play around next time: Kwang's Tainted Guard cuts the healing of anyone who basic-attacks him, so when Kwang is in the fight, Khaimera opens on Zinx or Argus and leaves Kwang to Greystone.
perPlayer.572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036: Gideon fought like a menace and added nothing to the part that actually ends games. Seven kills, two deaths and two clean skirmishes credited alongside Khaimera, then zero objective damage for the entire match. Not low. Zero. The kills were great; the towers and Primes never felt him. Next time he and Khaimera win a skirmish, Gideon follows onto the nearest objective or tower and shoots it until it falls.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Drongo with Greystone was lethal: both kill sequences they shared ended clean, three for nothing and two for nothing. The rest of his game was messier. Two late deaths came away from any recorded fight, and his hero damage sat well under his usual on the hero. Dead carries do no damage. Late game, Drongo rotates only with Greystone or Phase beside him, and in fights he fires from behind Greystone.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase did the support job on the map and gave too much away early. Twelve wards, all three of our ward clears and the team's biggest healing total are real work. Three early deaths, starting with first blood to Kwang, are not; that is less support and more delivery service. In the opening minutes, when Kwang has not shown on the map, Phase plays back from the wave and saves Phase Blink for the exit.

12.call: The kill sequence ended 5-1 with all five of us credited, and Fangtooth went to us in the same window. Kill credits place heroes in the fight; they do not show who started it.

17.7.call: Drongo and Greystone ended this sequence 3-0, while our Outer Tower fell in the same window with nobody of ours dead. The timing does not show which lane the tower was in or who could have defended it.

19.6.call: Gideon and Khaimera ended this sequence 3-0, but Fangtooth went to them in the same window after Phase and Drongo had both died. The order shows a trade; it does not prove the pit was contestable.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Duo lane: Phase with Drongo into Argus with Skylar, with Kwang taking first blood on Phase in that lane. Argus threatens from range with Dread Nova's stun and Ether Crystal's slow; Skylar finished Terminus lifesteal and Vanquisher. Across the team, Grux's Crush and Kwang's Surge of the Heavens are the two knockups that can lock whichever ally Phase has linked.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Tainted Scepter has real targets here: it cuts healing on anything Phase hits with magical damage, which covers Skylar's Terminus lifesteal, the omnivamp from Kwang's Aura of the Heavens and Grux's own healing. Prophecy adds on-hit magical damage and attack speed to her basic attacks, a damage choice rather than protection. Galaxy Greaves gives both armors against a mixed enemy team. The final inventory does not show how often Blighted Spells actually landed.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Lotus rolls a random bonus on a timer and on takedowns. Flawless heals Phase and nearby allies once per ability hit on an enemy hero, which suits a heal-and-link plan. Prima Donna adds damage to heroes but makes Phase take more damage from every source; on a support with three early deaths, that is the trade to question. Immaculate, damage reduction while above 85% health, is the defensive option in the same slot.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst restore mana to the linked ally. It helps a mana-hungry partner, but the record does not show who was linked or whether mana was ever short. Kindred Surge instead gives Hyperflux extra movement speed and health regeneration for its duration, a more direct escape and sustain tool for a duo that lost both of its two-man fights.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Tranquility fits the job: a group heal with brief damage mitigation, a third ward slot and Solstone income. Twelve wards placed and all three of our ward clears show the vision side of it was used. The record does not show when Grace was cast or who was in range for it.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Enra's Blessing, part of the recommended core, shields any nearby ally who gets immobilized, and this enemy team brought two knockups plus Argus's stun. Taking it over Prophecy trades basic-attack damage for protection that triggers exactly when Grux or Kwang lands control on Drongo. If Prophecy stays, the cheaper safety buy is Immaculate over Prima Donna in the Lotus slot.

572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.matchup: Mid opponent: Zinx, built on Prophecy, Orion and Spectra, and the enemy's top damage dealer, almost all of it magical. Zinx heals allies and can revive them but cannot heal herself, which makes her the target to burst first. Grux and Kwang are the divers who can reach Gideon during Black Hole's channel, and both carry a knockup.
572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.build: Soulbinder adds bonus damage to ability hits from long range and grows Magical Power each time it triggers. Truesilver Bracelet shields Gideon on ultimate cast and makes him immune to crowd control while the shield holds, a direct answer to Grux and Kwang knockups during Black Hole. Oblivion Crown multiplies the power. Against the Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings core, this trades area burst for range and channel safety.
572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.eternal: Vesh adds damage over time to his ability damage on heroes. Tithe of Death returns mana and permanent ability haste on takedowns, a good fit for a mid who collects kills. Phylactery adds cooldown progression and a mana-scaled shield after the ultimate, stacking with Truesilver's shield on Black Hole. Mind Rot is the damage alternative, paid for with that second layer of post-ultimate protection.
572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.augment: Infinite Impact gives Void Breach unlimited range, and that pairs neatly with Soulbinder, whose bonus only triggers on ability hits from far away. It is a coherent long-range poke plan. Event Horizon is the alternative into the Grux and Kwang health pools: extra max-health damage in the centre of Cosmic Rift, traded for the cross-map Void Breach. The record cannot show how many long Void Breach hits landed.
572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.crest: Obelisk empowers a basic attack and builds Magical Power from souls when the target dies soon after. It suits a mid who gets takedowns, but it is a pure damage crest with no escape or protection attached. The record does not show the soul count or how often Condemn finished a target.
572a6e3b-9780-413a-9d7f-1f0da3ed1036.improvement: Defensible keep. Two deaths do not point at a missing item, and Truesilver should stay while Grux and Kwang both carry knockups. If Zinx's magical damage starts forcing Gideon out of fights in a future game, a magical-armor item over Oblivion Crown trades raw power for survival. No inventory change touches objective damage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Duo lane: Drongo with Phase into Skylar with Argus. Skylar finished Plasma Blade, Terminus and Vanquisher, so she brings lifesteal sustain and her own execute. Kwang ended on Tainted Guard, which bleeds and cuts the healing of anyone who basic-attacks him, so Drongo's damage on Kwang comes with a cost. Kwang and Skylar between them were credited with four of Drongo's five deaths.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Lightning Hawk gives a slowing empowered shot built from moving and attacking, Vanquisher adds physical penetration and executes heroes below 5% health, and Imperator raises critical damage. Drongo's Wastelander bleed applies on crits, so the crit path feeds his passive. That is the standard carry spine; the only recommended piece missing is Tainted Rounds.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Drongo damages a hero below 30% health. Forage adds gold and XP per minion and monster kill, and Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash, which Pacifier's Adrenalize provides. The recommended pair is Dryad's Boon and Taproot. Natural Resistance is the safety alternative, a cleanse and tenacity below 25% health, traded for Forage income; it has a case into two knockups.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Shred Spree cuts Shrapnel Cannon's cooldown by 80% for half its damage, so the 30% physical armor shred comes up far more often. With four of our five heroes dealing physical damage, more frequent shred on Kwang and Grux helps the whole team, not just Drongo. The record does not show how often the shred connected.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Pacifier gives a short dash, an empowered physical hit that is much stronger below 20% health, and a recast after a kill. It is an aggressive crest whose dash can also be the exit. With two deaths away from any recorded fight, holding it as an escape is the safer default; the record does not show when it was used.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: Tainted Rounds over Imperator is the conditional swap: healing reduction on every basic hit against Skylar's Terminus lifesteal and the omnivamp from Kwang's aura, paid for with Imperator's extra critical damage. Take it when their carry or jungler is visibly healing through fights; skip it when nobody on their side sustains. Nothing in this match proves the current build lost a fight.

3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.matchup: Offlane opponent: Grux, a physical bruiser with Sky Splitter's current-health damage, Basilisk's armor shred and Crush's knockup. His healing makes anti-heal relevant, and he finished with the most deaths in the lobby. The team-level threat was different: Zinx was their top damage dealer, mostly magical, with Argus adding more magic on top.
3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.build: Tainted Blade cuts healing on every physical hit and makes blighted targets take more damage from his abilities, a direct answer to Grux. Augmentation empowers a basic attack after each cast. Aegis of Agawar adds percentage physical and magical armor, doubled below 40% health, and Giant's Ring adds physical armor plus cooldown refunds when he is basic-attacked. Aegis is the only magical defense in the build, which is why the engine flags missing magic resist.
3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.eternal: Nihil grows Greystone's stats while he keeps damaging heroes and makes part of that growth permanent on takedowns, which suits a frontline who stays in long fights. From the Abyss restores health during hero combat, and Adaptive Plating grants armor matching the damage type he takes, partly covering the magical side. It is the recommended pair and nothing in this match argues against it.
3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.augment: Imperial Soul makes Stone Forged Soul hit 12% harder over a 20% larger radius, so the stasis heal ends in a wider slam. That fits a frontline who wants to land the ultimate on several enemies at once. Tainted Oath is the anti-heal alternative, but Tainted Blade already covers that job.
3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.crest: Razorback adds both armors for a few seconds and reflects part of the damage he takes from heroes. Into a team that dives with two knockups, it is a sensible defensive crest. The record does not show when Echidna was active or how much it reflected.
3382512b-0b32-4920-9de6-dd2ba204849a.improvement: Defensible keep: zero deaths says the defenses held. If Zinx's magical damage starts breaking him in a future game, Absolution over Giant's Ring adds magical armor and tenacity, plus mitigation and speed when he is immobilized, at the cost of Giant's Ring's physical armor and its cooldown refunds.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Jungle opponent: Kwang, built on Megacosm, Tainted Guard and Prophecy with the Aura of the Heavens omnivamp augment. Tainted Guard punishes basic attackers with a bleed and reduced healing, and Argus's Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical hits: two direct answers to Khaimera's regeneration-based sustain. Khaimera's credited kills were spread across Kwang, Zinx, Grux and Argus.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Ashbringer shortens non-ultimate cooldowns on every basic hit, more on crits. Claw of Hermes burns mana on hits, and its Magical Power adds extra Unleash attacks, since Unleash gains one per 30 Magical Power. Nuclear Rounds raises ability damage based on critical chance. It is an ability-amp skirmish build instead of the recommended Sky Splitter and Onixian Quiver core, and it carries no lifesteal item.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Exarch triggers when Khaimera heals or shields himself, granting attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage for a few seconds. Revelation trims basic cooldowns on every cast, and Fervour heals him and nearby allies on hero hits. The pieces connect to a self-healing kit, but Exarch is built for supports, and enemy anti-heal shrinks the healing it rewards. The record does not show proc uptime.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle and doubles it in the enemy jungle, rewarding a jungler who invades and fights on their side of the map. Feral Ambush, a longer leap, and Lane Lurker are the alternatives; nothing in this match makes a clear case for either over it.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Judgement deals area damage and heals on hero hits, with its cooldown shortening as he levels. It stacks with his regeneration and Fervour into a sustain package, and the same enemy anti-heal applies to it. The record does not show how many heroes each cast hit.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: Into Tainted Guard and Tainted Scepter, Onixian Quiver over Nuclear Rounds is the swap to compare: lifesteal, extra critical chance for melee heroes and mitigation as health drops, paid for with Nuclear Rounds' ability-damage boost and ability haste. Keep the current build while Khaimera is clearing objectives this fast without dying much.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
